parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb 0.830066. It seems decreasing ASPECT_RATIO might be working, or my previous LR/warmup balance was closer to optimal than I thought. I'll keep this config and try a further reduction in ASPECT_RATIO to see if a narrower, more efficient width helps convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 32 to test if increased width efficiency improves val_bpb.
